description.tagline: Professional grip to celebrate Unai Simon
description.intro: Reusch Attrakt Freegel Fusion Uni Simon WC Champion’s goalkeeper gloves combine grip, fit and stability to respond to the maximum level under the three sticks. Reusch Grip Fusion palm provides reliable contact with the ball in different weather conditions, while Evolution Negative Cut cut and anatomical construction provide a tight and natural feel in each intervention.
description.collection: UNAI SIMÓN PACK + WC26 Champion Registration
key_benefits: World winner registration 26: UNAI SIMÓN - WORLD CAMPION - 19/07/2026.
Glove holder included: Includes a glove holder to store and carry gloves comfortably and keep them protected when not in use.
High-level grip: The palm offers reliable adhesion to control the ball in both dry and wet conditions.
Precise fit: Its tight construction adapts to the hand to provide safety and sensitivity during blocs and receptions.
Greater contact surface: The extension of the palm around different areas of the hand favors a wider contact with the ball.
Natural comfort: The anatomical shape and the arrangement of the fingers facilitate a comfortable position of the hand during the game.
Stability on the wrist: The locking system helps to maintain a firm and secure hold during the most demanding actions.
